onboarding.slide1Desc: Your daily productivity companion. Build customizable 24-hour routine profiles, align your schedule with prayer times, and track your daily momentum.
onboarding.slide2Desc: Visualize your occupied hours and interstitial free time on an interactive 24-hour timeline bar with a live current-time pointer.
onboarding.slide3Desc: Unexpected illness or travel? Create an emergency event to temporarily suspend daily activities without altering your routine templates. "Important" tasks remain active.
onboarding.slide4Desc: Dayflow saves all your profiles and routines into your local "dayflow_backup" folder. Your data survives app uninstallation and stays 100% private on your phone.
onboarding.slide5Desc: Start organizing your day by customizing your routine profiles. Have a productive and fulfilling day!
